title: Ranking a measure needs a table that ignores the current filter: ALL
query: "Rank", IF ( NOT ISBLANK ( [Sales Amount] ), RANKX ( ALL ( Product[Product] ), [Sales Amount] ) )

source.quote: RANKX starts iterating the table with all the brands, and for each row it computes the Sales Amount measure.
source.supports: the measure is evaluated for every row of the table by context transition

source.quote: We could have used ALL instead of ALLSELECTED .
source.supports: ALL gives the full list whatever the current filter

derivation: Sales Amount by product: Bike 100 + 200 + 100 = 400, Lock 50 + 30 = 80, Helmet 40 + 20 = 60, Scooter BLANK. For each group the list is built over all four products (400, 80, 60 and the BLANK of Scooter) and the amount of the group is looked up: Bike 1, Lock 2, Helmet 3. Scooter has a BLANK amount, the IF leaves its rank BLANK too, and SUMMARIZECOLUMNS drops the row.
